component.name: LazyCoffee TOTP
LazyCoffee TOTP
component.summary: 安全、私密的双因素身份验证与凭据管理器

description.p: LazyCoffee TOTP is a lightweight, elegant, and secure Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / TOTP) and credential manager. Designed with privacy first, it safeguards your accounts with transparent client-side encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.
LazyCoffee TOTP 是一款轻量、优雅且安全的双因素身份验证 (2FA / TOTP) 与身份凭据管理器。 遵循隐私优先设计，采用高强度客户端透明加密与零知识架构，全方位守护您的数字资产。

ul.li: Zero-knowledge credential encryption based on AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2 derived master keys
Emergency 24-word/alphanumeric recovery key for safe key-reset workflows
Full credential management: TOTP dynamic codes, passwords, URLs, and encrypted notes
Offline dynamic code generation adhering strictly to RFC 6238 and RFC 4226 standards
Smart brand icon recognition with thousands of built-in platform logos
Seamless multi-folder hierarchy, custom sorting, and quick tag filtering
High-compatibility imports from Bitwarden, Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, and CSV
System keyring integration and local biometric security locking
基于 AES-256-GCM 与 PBKDF2 强派生密钥的零知识客户端凭证数据加密
24 位应急恢复逃生密钥（Recovery Key），杜绝数据丢失
全能凭据管理：2FA 动态口令、登录密码、服务网址与加密安全备忘录
严格遵循 RFC 6238 / RFC 4226 国际标准，完全断网离线秒级计算
智能品牌图标识别，内置海量主流网站与系统平台专属 Logo
重构文件夹管理体系，支持拖拽自定义排序与横向分类快速筛选
全面兼容 Bitwarden、Google Authenticator、Aegis、2FAS 及标准 CSV 导入
系统密钥链（Keyring）集成与本地生物识别防偷窥安全锁

ul.li: Folder management overhaul: responsive dialogs, drag & drop custom ordering, and horizontal quick filtering
Refactored credential card collapsed state focusing on core account clarity and high-contrast color pills
Centralized lightweight AppToast feedback system with instant undo
Enhanced URL parsing and expanded compatibility for Bitwarden, Google Authenticator, and 2FAS
Hardened client-side credential encryption and performance optimizations across desktop platforms
【文件夹管理重构】全面重构文件夹管理体系，支持拖拽自定义排序与横向分类快速筛选
【卡片视觉升级】凭据卡片折叠态全面优化，空间聚焦核心账号信息，微胶囊高辨识度标签
【全局交互反馈】统一居中高对比度轻量提示（AppToast），支持快捷撤销与丝滑微交互
【第三方导入兼容】深度优化网址匹配容错，全面兼容 Bitwarden、Google Authenticator 无损导入
